edges.description: Blocking the first activation step depletes both the circulating intermediate and the active hormone.
Reduced calcium and phosphate supply lowers the calcium-phosphate product at the mineralization front.

nodes.description: With no 25-hydroxyvitamin D substrate, the intact renal 1-alpha-hydroxylase has nothing to act on, and calcitriol falls as well. Vitamin D receptor signalling in the intestine declines, active calcium absorption falls, and the calciopenic cascade of hypocalcemia, secondary hyperparathyroidism and phosphaturia follows. This is the disorder-specific instance of the module's calciopenic trigger arm, with the interruption placed at 25-hydroxylation.

evidence.reference_title: Genetic evidence that the human CYP2R1 enzyme is a key vitamin D 25-hydroxylase.
evidence.snippet: These data identify CYP2R1 as a biologically relevant vitamin D 25-hydroxylase and reveal the molecular basis of a human genetic disease, selective 25-hydroxyvitamin D deficiency.

nodes.description: Failure to mineralize newly formed osteoid and the growing metaphysis, presenting as rickets with the radiographic and clinical features indistinguishable from nutritional rickets.

evidence.reference_title: CYP2R1 Mutations Impair Generation of 25-hydroxyvitamin D and Cause an Atypical Form of Vitamin D Deficiency.
evidence.snippet: This study aimed to determine the prevalence of CYP2R1 mutations in Nigerian children with familial rickets and vitamin D deficiency and assess the functional effect on 25-hydroxylase activity.

nodes.description: CYP2R1 is the principal microsomal enzyme that hydroxylates carbon 25 of vitamin D in the liver, the first of the two activation steps. Loss-of-function variants eliminate this activity, so ingested or cutaneously synthesized vitamin D cannot be converted to 25-hydroxyvitamin D. Unlike type 1A, where the substrate accumulates, here the pathway is starved from the top and both metabolites are low.

evidence.reference_title: Genetic evidence that the human CYP2R1 enzyme is a key vitamin D 25-hydroxylase.
evidence.snippet: The inherited mutation caused the substitution of a proline for an evolutionarily conserved leucine at amino acid 99 in the CYP2R1 protein and eliminated vitamin D 25-hydroxylase enzyme activity.

evidence.reference_title: CYP2R1 Mutations Impair Generation of 25-hydroxyvitamin D and Cause an Atypical Form of Vitamin D Deficiency.
evidence.snippet: in vitro studies showed that K242N and L99P had markedly reduced or complete loss of 25-hydroxylase activity, respectively

nodes.description: Pharmacological rather than physiological doses of PARENT vitamin D (cholecalciferol or ergocalciferol) can drive residual or alternative 25-hydroxylase activity sufficiently to raise 25-hydroxyvitamin D. Responding to parent vitamin D at high dose is the clinical signature that separates type 1B from type 1A, where the activation step is gone and calcitriol is required, and from types 2A and 2B, which respond to no dose of any form. Treatment is lifelong and patients relapse when the dose is reduced; a subset of homozygotes requires calcitriol in addition.
